newsitem.title: USA: Outboard Marine in engine pact with Suzuki.
newsitem.headline: Outboard Marine in engine pact with Suzuki.

text.p: Outboard Marine Corp and Suzuki Motor Corp of Japan said Tuesday they signed a long-term agreement under which Outboard Marine will purchase selected outboard engines from Suzuki.
Outboard Marine will market these products under the Johnson and Evinrude brand names.

"Both companies will be stronger and more competitive in global markets," Hank Bowman, Outboard Marine chairman, said in a statement. "This agreement also will enable OMC to continue to focus its resources on the development of our proprietary FICHT fuel injection technology and its applications."
Outboard Marine said it expects to introduce its expanded product line later this year. Parts and service for these products will be available through its dealer network.
Outboard Marine currently has approximately 10,000 dealers worldwide.

Bowman also said that Outboard Marine was continuing its previously announced effort to pursue strategic alternatives to enhance shareholder value. He said the effort was on schedule with the projected timetable.

In April, Outboard Marine said it was exploring strategic options that could include a sale of the company, merger, joint venture or equity offer. At the time, it said it hoped to complete its exploration process within 60 to 90 days.
